description_en: Invokes this operation to query the logs of a scene orchestration rule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询场景联动规则日志
name: QuerySummarySceneRuleLog

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scene orchestration rule. Invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169498.html operation to obtain the scene orchestration rule ID
parameters.help_zh: 场景联动规则ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169498.html接口获取场景联动规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the scene orchestration rule logs, in seconds. Specify a UNIX timestamp.

You can query rule execution logs only for the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
场景联动规则日志的开始时间，单位为秒，输入Unix时间戳。

最多可查询近一个月（30天）的规则执行日志
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the scene orchestration rule logs, in seconds. Specify a UNIX timestamp.

You can query rule execution logs only for the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
场景联动规则日志的结束时间，单位为秒，输入Unix时间戳。

最多可查询近一个月（30天）的规则执行日志
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The execution result of the scene orchestration rule.

0: failed.

1: succeeded
parameters.help_zh:
场景联动规则的执行结果。

0：表示失败。

1：表示成功
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1
parameters.name: current_page

Code.description_en: The response code. Success indicates success. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量

Total.description_en: The total number of scene orchestration rule logs
Total.description_zh: 场景联动规则日志总数量

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
